title: ci_approval_content_envelope
note: KEYLESS v3.1.5 REWRITE. The v1 schema (myco.l1.governance.attestation_envelope.v1, 'contract_identity_attestation_request') modeled the REMOVED owner-attestation envelope: owner_signature (operator_witness), anchor_surface_nonce, and anchor wall-clock expiry. With the owner key + anchor surface retired (see docs/architecture/L0/cards/AS_anchor_surface.md), that signature-bearing envelope no longer exists and had no live producer or consumer. What survives is the KEPT C5 attestation, which validates the CONTENT of a CI-class mutation (NOT a signature): the substrate emits the proposed mutation as canonical-bytes, and the cultivator renders + re-derives the hash at the live human-in-the-loop CI gate, then approves or rejects in the loop. Trust root is the live human at the gate + the substrate's causal DAG (P06) + the BLAKE3-sealed doctrine bundle; there is no nonce, owner signature, or trusted wall-clock stamp. This minimal v2 schema documents that surviving content envelope. The live producer/validator is substrate/src/attestation.rs (handle_submit_mutation + the C5_attestation_invalid local content checks); C5 is rowed at L1/HARD_RULES §1 and the flow at L1/GOVERNANCE §2.2-§2.3.

type.description: Keyless v3.1.5; was 'contract_identity_attestation_request' (the owner-signature request envelope, retired).

substrate_id.description: Substrate-ID fixed post-genesis (keyless v3.1.5: derived without owner-pubkey / anchor-endpoint inputs).

dag_tip_hash.description: Current Merkle DAG tip (per L1/SCHEMA §2.2). The cultivator confirms tip currency at the live CI gate using substrate-cycle ordering (P06), not an anchor wall-clock.

enumerated_dag_nodes_since_last_co_sign.description: All DAG node hashes added since the prior CI approval (not a summary diff); enables Merkle-chain closure check so the substrate cannot hide a parallel-branch forgery. Re-derived by the cultivator at the live human-in-the-loop CI gate.

mutation_type.description: The CI-class mutation whose CONTENT the kept C5 attestation validates. The live keyless validators (substrate/src/attestation.rs) cover: owner_objective_declaration (F20 telos objective content), the compression-witness (compression-rule content), and set_backup_encryption_status (backup-status content); plus schema-evolution. Malformed content for any of these emits C5_attestation_invalid and is rejected with no DAG churn.

proposed_mutation_canonical_bytes.description: Canonical-bytes (F16) of the proposed mutation content; the substrate emits, the cultivator renders deterministically at the live CI gate (the substrate does not render or self-assert 'pass').

proposed_mutation_hash.description: Hash over the canonical-bytes; re-derived by the cultivator at the live CI gate and compared (keyless v3.1.5: this is the integrity check that replaces the retired owner signature).

request_timestamp_substrate_cycles.description: Substrate-cycle counter for within-substrate ordering (P06 + L1/CONTINUITY time semantics). Keyless v3.1.5: this is the only time field; the prior anchor wall-clock expiry is retired (acknowledged-debt: no external trusted clock, so CI approval is a live-human act with no security-bearing expiry timer).

x-retired-v1-fields.note: Removed with the owner key + anchor surface (keyless v3.1.5); listed here for provenance only, not part of the keyless envelope.
x-retired-v1-fields.operator_witness: owner/operator signature over the canonical-bytes hash; retired (no owner key gates CI).
x-retired-v1-fields.operator_signing_key_public: owner-side verifying key cross-checked against an anchor-logged handshake; retired.
x-retired-v1-fields.anchor_surface_nonce: single-use anchor-minted nonce bound to (mutation_hash, dag_tip_hash); retired (sampling/derivation is now substrate/DAG-tip-derived).
x-retired-v1-fields.expiry_constraints.wall_clock_seconds_ma: anchor wall-clock expiry; retired (no external trusted clock).
